title: Suffixes -ful, -less, -ive · Roots scrib/script, tract, rupt, vis/vid · How Simple Machines Work
goal: Read, spell, and use words with *-ful, -less, -ive*; learn four more commonly-useful roots; return to the standard single-passage fluency format (no more scripts or phrase-cues from here on — full independent pacing).
newToday: suffixes *-ful* ("full of"), *-less* ("without"), *-ive* ("having the quality/tendency of"); roots *scrib/script* (write), *tract* (pull/drag), *rupt* (break), *vis/vid* (see). Tier-2 words: *assist*, *reduce*.
review: *spect, port, dict, struct* — one example word each, quick oral round.
